About

Motion is how I think.
Stories are what I make.

I'm a Senior Motion Designer & Video Producer based in Cairo, Egypt, with 7+ years of experience producing motion graphics, 2D/3D animation, and performance-driven video content for agencies and global brands.

I work at the intersection of craft and performance — using AI tools like Adobe Firefly and Runway alongside After Effects, Cinema 4D, Figma, and Lottie to move faster without sacrificing quality.
